Dravelance is a physical quantity measur.why: Dravelance is a made-up name for a physical quantity: no hits in Dolma under either capitalisation. New quantities are defined in papers all the time, so one could exist unrecorded, and no recorded quantity occupies its slot.

Dravelance is measured in the same SI un.why: Dravelance is made up, so no text compares its unit with energy's; people say that energy is measured in joules, but nobody says it of a made-up quantity. It follows from the edit and the energy premise.
